name: Warzone Utils
description: A client-side PvP information and camera effect mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric. It shows combat readouts on the HUD (damage you deal, floating damage numbers, aimed target name/health/armor/distance, potion duration), provides sliders for view bobbing and camera effects, keeps a local PvP hit log with its own viewer, saves screenshots on kill or death, and lets you view the last ender chest contents you opened. Every feature is opt-in and client-side; no gameplay data is sent anywhere.
